prompt: The new highway increases air pollution, to (say / tell) nothing of the constant traffic noise.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение «to say nothing of...» (не говоря уже о...) всегда употребляется с глаголом say.

prompt: We managed to (say / talk) Elena into leading the new design project.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол «talk someone into doing something» означает «уговорить кого-то сделать что-то».

prompt: During the meeting, everyone was encouraged to (speak / tell) their mind about the proposed changes.
explanation_ru: Идиома «speak one's mind» означает «высказывать своё мнение прямо и откровенно».

prompt: In this morning's briefing, economic analysts (said / told) that interest rates would remain unchanged until autumn.
explanation_ru: После глагола «say» сразу идёт придаточное с «that» без прямого дополнения (кому сказали).

prompt: Hold my luggage for a second — I need to (say / tell) something to the ticket inspector.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «say something to someone» требует глагола «say» и предлога «to» перед адресатом.

prompt: Nobody has (said / told) the new developer how to access the staging database yet.
explanation_ru: Модель «tell someone how to do something» используется для передачи инструкций конкретному человеку.

prompt: Please submit your report in a portable format, that is to (say / speak), as a PDF rather than an editable document.
explanation_ru: Вводная конструкция «that is to say» (то есть, иначе говоря) фиксирована с глаголом «say».

prompt: Instead of ignoring the disagreement, you and your brother should sit down and (speak / talk) it out.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол «talk something out» означает «подробно обсудить проблему, чтобы прийти к решению».

prompt: Needless to (say / tell), missing the last ferry forced us to book a hotel room for the night.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое вводное выражение «needless to say» переводится как «само собой разумеется».

prompt: During the inquiry, the director (said / told) very little to the committee about the missing funds.
explanation_ru: С словами «little», «much», «something» и предлогом «to» перед адресатом используется «say».

prompt: Maya texted me twenty minutes ago and (said / told) she would be arriving on the late train. She also (said / told) me that she had already bought the concert tickets. I (said / told) to her that I would meet her at the station.
explanation_ru: «Say» используется без адресата или с предлогом «to» (said to her), а «tell» — сразу с прямым дополнением (told me).

prompt: Most critics are (saying / telling) that the new exhibition is far more engaging than last year's show. Even local bloggers (say / tell) the interactive rooms are worth the ticket price. However, the museum guide (said / told) visitors not to touch the fragile sculptures.
explanation_ru: Для передачи общего мнения без указания слушателя берём «say», а для запрета/инструкции с адресатом (visitors not to...) — «tell».

prompt: “These organic vegetables have gotten ridiculously expensive,” Clara sighed at the checkout. “You can (say / tell) that again,” replied her friend, looking at the receipt. Then the cashier (said / told) them about the weekend discount card.
explanation_ru: Фраза «You can say that again» выражает полное согласие; конструкция «tell someone about something» требует «tell».

prompt: The coach warned the players not to (say / talk) back to the referee during the match. Last week, one midfielder (said / talked) rudely to the official and received a yellow card. Good sportsmanship means knowing when to (speak / tell) respectfully.
explanation_ru: «Talk back to someone» означает «дерзить, пререкаться»; «talk/speak rudely/respectfully» описывает манеру речи.

prompt: The soufflé collapsed in the oven? Well, I (said / told) you so! I (said / told) earlier that opening the oven door too soon would ruin it. Next time, please (say / tell) me before you check the timer.
explanation_ru: Устойчивая фраза «I told you so» (Я же тебе говорил) требует «told», как и «tell me»; без адресата перед «that» ставится «said».

prompt: At no point during the press briefing did the spokesperson (say / tell) that the factory would close permanently. Instead, she (said / told) reporters that management was reviewing all options. Several union leaders later (said / talked) about the need for transparency.
explanation_ru: После «say» идёт придаточное «that...» без объекта; «told reporters» имеет прямой объект; «talked about» означает «говорили о».

prompt: Liam ___ that he had left his wallet on the kitchen counter.
explanation_ru: Перед придаточным предложением с «that» без указания собеседника используется только глагол «said».

prompt: The client left the conference room without ___ what he thought of the updated budget.
explanation_ru: После «say» может сразу идти косвенный вопрос («what he thought...») без упоминания адресата.

prompt: I promise I won't ___ on you if you return the borrowed tablet right now.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол «tell on someone» означает «наябедничать, донести на кого-то».

prompt: Could someone ___ David out of quitting the swim team right before the finals?
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол «talk someone out of doing something» означает «отговорить кого-то от чего-то».

prompt: At yesterday's community meeting, Nadia told up for the local library.
answer: At yesterday's community meeting, Nadia spoke up for the local library.
accepted_answers: At yesterday's community meeting, Nadia spoke up for the local library.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол «speak up for someone/something» означает «выступить в защиту кого-либо или чего-либо».

prompt: The mountain guide strictly said the hikers not to leave the marked trail in heavy snow.
answer: The mountain guide strictly told the hikers not to leave the marked trail in heavy snow.
accepted_answers: The mountain guide strictly told the hikers not to leave the marked trail in heavy snow.
explanation_ru: Для передачи приказа или предупреждения с инфинитивом («tell someone not to do something») используется «told», а не «said».

prompt: “This pasta needs a little more black pepper,” Grandma said after tasting the sauce.
answer: “This pasta needs a little more black pepper,” Grandma said after tasting the sauce.
accepted_answers: “This pasta needs a little more black pepper,” Grandma said after tasting the sauce.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: при введении прямой речи без указания адресата правильно используется глагол «said».

prompt: Outside the theatre, an actor comments directly to his colleague about the terrible sound system. Which sentence is grammatically natural?
options: “I've never worked with such poor acoustics,” the actor said to his colleague outside the theatre.
“I've never worked with such poor acoustics,” the actor told to his colleague outside the theatre.
“I've never worked with such poor acoustics,” the actor said his colleague outside the theatre.
“I've never worked with such poor acoustics,” the actor spoke his colleague outside the theatre.
explanation_ru: В прямой речи с указанием собеседника используется «said to + лицо» (или «told + лицо» без предлога «to»).

prompt: Rewrite the sentence using the correct form of speak: Let the craftsmanship show its own value before you mention the price.
answer: Let the craftsmanship speak for itself before you mention the price.
accepted_answers: Let the craftsmanship speak for itself before you mention the price.
explanation_ru: Идиома «speak for itself» означает «говорить само за себя, не нуждаться в дополнительных доказательствах».
